claims.claim_text: GitHub 發現一件反直覺的事：給 code review agent 塞進更多、更強的工具，審查品質反而下降。
claims.evidence: when we tested the shared tools in offline benchmarks, the review agent became less efficient and less effective. Average cost increased, and the number of useful comments dropped.
claims.note: Source confirms more/shared tools degraded review effectiveness; root cause attributed to instructions tuned for CLI implying wrong workflow ('The tools themselves worked, but their instructions were tuned for their use within the Copilot CLI and implied the wrong workflow').

claims.claim_text: 重新設計工作流程之後，審查成本降了約兩成。
claims.evidence: the tuned behavior showed roughly 20% lower average review cost compared with the control.
claims.note: Cost reduction (~20%) is supported, but the source makes NO claim about latency dropping. The lede asserts both cost AND latency fell; the latency half is unsupported. Correct to what the source says (cost only) or drop the latency claim. [FIXED round2: dropped unsupported latency claim; kept ~20% cost reduction which the source states.]

claims.claim_text: Meta 把大規模的廣告服務改用一顆開源的 Linux 核心排程器來分配 CPU，取代原本的預設排程行為。
claims.evidence: we turned to sched_ext — the upstream, BPF-based extensible scheduling framework — to build a scheduling policy customized to the Ads delivery workload. [...] from kernel 6.4 with the CFS scheduler to kernel 6.9 with sched_ext.
claims.note: Open-source (sched_ext, upstream BPF-based) kernel scheduler replacing the default CFS scheduler for the ads workload — confirmed, including the pluggable/customizable framing.

claims.claim_text: Chrome 148 把原本內建的 fdlibm 數學函式庫換成作業系統原生的實作，結果像 sin、cos 這類運算在不同平台上算出來的浮點結果出現細微差異，這些差異足以拿來做瀏覽器指紋辨識。
claims.evidence: Until Chrome 148, V8 computed tanh itself with a bundled fdlibm port, so it returned the same bits on every OS and leaked nothing. V8 commit c1486295ae5 replaced it with std::tanh, which reads the host libm. [...] The two disagree on about a quarter of all inputs, usually by one unit in the last place (1 ULP).
claims.note: Source uses tanh as its worked example (lede says sin/cos as illustrative of 'these kinds of' math ops); the mechanism — swap to host libm producing per-platform float differences usable for fingerprinting — is fully supported.

claims.claim_text: 技術社群站 lobste.rs 把生產環境的資料庫從 MariaDB 換成了 SQLite。
claims.evidence: lobste.rs migrated its production database from MariaDB to SQLite [...] 'cpu usage is down, memory usage is down, site seems to be snappier' [...] '1/2 the vps cost once mariadb vps is taken down.'
claims.note: Production migration MariaDB→SQLite confirmed, along with the tradeoffs/perf discussion the lede references.

claims.claim_text: 代號 GhostLock 的漏洞，一個存在於所有主流 Linux 發行版、時間長達約十五年的 stack use-after-free。
claims.evidence: GhostLock, a stack-UAF that has existed in ALL Linux distributions for 15 years [...] GhostLock was introduced in Linux 2.6.39 and fixed in Linux 7.1. It has existed in the Linux kernel for more than 15 years
claims.note: Codename, stack-UAF type, all-distros scope, and ~15-year span all confirmed verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 在一段熱迴圈裡加上一個看起來完全多餘的 if 分支，反而讓吞吐量翻了四倍。
claims.evidence: In a synthetic benchmark, this change has sped up the loop from 320 us to 80 us on my data.
claims.note: 4x (320→80us) matches the source's headline framing ('quadrupling ... with a useless if') and the branch-prediction/code-layout mechanism the lede describes. Caveat worth noting: source adds 'In a more realistic experiment, I only witnessed a 2× increase' — the 4x is the synthetic-benchmark figure, not universal. Verified at stated strength given the article's own title, but the realistic 2x qualifier is not surfaced in the lede.

claims.claim_text: 有人把 Apple 在裝置端跑的 SpeechAnalyzer API 拿去跟 OpenAI 的 Whisper、以及 Apple 自家舊的語音 API 做準確度與延遲的實測比較。
claims.evidence: We measured it against the API it replaces and against Whisper, on 5,559 standard test utterances, and released every transcript.
claims.note: On-device SpeechAnalyzer benchmarked against Whisper and the legacy Apple API (SFSpeechRecognizer) for accuracy (WER) and speed — confirmed.

claims.claim_text: Netflix 把數以百萬計的批次工作，從自家維護的 CMB 系統搬到雲端原生的 Kubernetes 排隊系統 Kueue，換來以搶佔為基礎的公平分享與更好的資源利用率。
claims.evidence: Kueue, a cloud-native job queueing system for batch workloads, which has largely replaced the custom queuing and scheduling logic in our homegrown managed batch solution Compute Managed Batch (CMB). [...] Preemption-based Fair Sharing allows Netflix Batch to maintain reservation semantics while lending resources to other tenants [...] Compute has seen a significant increase in average resource utilization.
claims.note: Millions of batch jobs, CMB→Kueue migration, preemption-based fair sharing, and improved utilization all confirmed. (CMB = 'Compute Managed Batch' per source; lede's '自家維護的 CMB 系統' is accurate.)
